data_audit.conclusion: R3 does not contain a deduplicated, checksum-clean 2023-01-01 through 2026-05-31 dataset. M2 cannot be a 1066-day strict order-flow replay.

R0.reason: The test fixtures reject 15 canaries, but the real registry violates the same running/terminal, git, argv/runtime and trace contracts.

R1.reason: The single-symbol engine had ladder, cost, reserve, leverage, liquidation and drawdown errors. The corrected BTC replay is useful only as a forensic diagnostic and is not a shared multi-symbol production engine.

R2.reason: The committed execution state itself lists R2 as remaining; registry fit cutoffs are empty and no immutable per-block fit evidence exists.

R3.reason: All three manifests contain checksum failures or incomplete coverage; metrics and bookDepth also contain duplicate keys.

R4.reason: Scored M1 uses RelaxedM1 instead of the five required conditions; M2 remaps 0.2/1.0% to 1/2% and consumes current buckets; E1 was implemented without the required source.

R5.reason: The committed execution state lists R5 as remaining and there is no complete activation manifest proving each parameter changes canonical orders.

G0.reason: The committed execution state lists G0 as remaining; later broad grids therefore ran after a failed predecessor gate.

G1.reason: The harness skips empty blocks, resets the position cycle at every block, uses per-block DD maxima rather than a continuous running peak and can mark a single-symbol row complete despite 100% symbol contribution.

G2.reason: Partial fills, leg delays and rejects are represented by slippage/filter changes rather than order events; LOSO runs each symbol separately; funding and a complete trial correction are absent.

R8.reason: The multi-symbol grid sums independently funded accounts, the selected BTC row is single-symbol, and terminal-only R8 registry rows have no replay provenance.

HANDOFF.reason: The handoff conflicts with the authority/state files and is not generated from strict-valid trace-backed experiments.

code_findings.finding: The launcher writes empty argv, zero wall/RSS, equal start/end timestamps and an empty fit cutoff into every running row.
Missing order/signal/margin streams are padded with the known empty SHA-256 instead of failing closed.
The implemented state machine always returns BLOCKED after R0; the committed valid state was written outside this derivation.
The scored replay deliberately replaces the planned strict five-condition M1 gate with a relaxed price-extension/OI gate.
The implementation remaps requested 0.2/1.0% depth to 1/2% and uses the current aggTrade bucket without a completed-bucket lag.
Each symbol receives an independent budget and account; equity curves are summed afterward, so this is not shared cash/margin/reserve execution.
max_sym_gross is computed from ending equity share, DSR uses n_trials=1 and PBO treats symbols as competing policies.
Each block calls a fresh single-symbol engine, empty blocks are skipped, and stitched DD is only the maximum of per-block DD values.
Partial-fill and delay stress only inflate slippage; no canonical partial order, delayed leg or hedge-or-flatten event occurs.
LOSO is implemented as one independent single-symbol replay per symbol, not leave-one-symbol-out on a multi-symbol policy.
The scored gated-Martin path reports funding as zero and never books funding cashflows.
MicroIntegral explicitly reconstructs SSRN 5895159 from an abstract and discussion despite the plan forbidding implementation without a PDF hash and formula pages.

corrected_engine_changes: use the first safety layer at 1.25x rather than skipping to 1.55x
include opening and closing fee/slippage in cycle-net TP and SO eligibility
reserve margin, maintenance, closing cost and the following SO
apply the leverage cap to projected notional
check event-time maintenance and terminate breached accounts at zero
include forced-close costs in final equity
calculate drawdown from a continuous running peak
report actual peak leverage and accumulated fees/slippage

source_violation.reason: SSRN response is Cloudflare HTML rather than a PDF, and no formula page or verbatim variable map exists. The 540-cell result cannot close or rank the claimed source mechanism.
